items.title: fix: keep Node fixtures portable under Bun (#145064)
items.summary: fix: keep Node fixtures portable under Bun (#145064) Fix Bun-hosted OpenClaw tests that accidentally launched Bun for Node-specific subprocesses. Resolve and verify an actual Node executable, including when `bun --bun` injects a `node` shim, and use it for runtime recovery, service repair, and Node heap-option fixtures. Normalize read-only filesystem inventories and agent-session cleanup ordering so Node and Bun observe the same stable sequence. No dependency is added. Verification: `pnpm check:changed`; exact custom Bun `13bd48ed77` with 213 focused passes; Node integration and resolver regressions; independent P0-P2 review clean.
